usedFor: Cal.com holds your bookings, and Google Contacts stores the people when “Booking Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal.com, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A new booking saves the person who booked as a contact, so your address book fills itself.

watchOut: “Booking Reschedules” also triggers, so the same person can reach “Create Contact” again after a move.
